item.name: auth
Sign in with email and password (BRQ-1.1; one answer for every failure, BR-27)

request.name: Sign in with email and password (BRQ-1.1; one answer for every failure, BR-27)

description.content:
Returns a 15-minute access token in the body and sets a 7-day refresh token in the
httpOnly `vtmp_rt` cookie (path /api/v1/auth). Wrong email, wrong password and
deactivated accounts all return the same 401. After `auth.maxFailedLogins` failures the
account is locked for `auth.lockMinutes`; a locked account also gets that same 401
INVALID_CREDENTIALS (whose message mentions the lock), so the answer never shows that
an email exists. Admins can unlock it. Rate-limited per IP.
Added as a part of security scheme: bearer

description.content: Checks the switch, the per-student daily limit (assistant.dailyLimitPerUser) and the monthly cap in US dollars (AI_MONTHLY_CAP), then searches approved materials of the student's own courses. Below assistant.minSimilarity it declines (refused NOT_IN_MATERIALS) without calling the model. The model receives only the excerpts, the question and the reply language, never the student's personal data (NFR-13). Practice mode returns multiple-choice questions validated on the server. Every request is logged with excerpts, tokens, cost and latency.
